title.narrative: COVID-19: Active Response and Expenditure Support Program

description.narrative: The Program will, in the short term, help the Government of Kyrgyz Republic mitigate the significant negative economic and fiscal impact of the coronavirus COVID-19 pandemic. The government's planned fiscal stimulus package will protect essential social services, while taking credible steps to contain the spread of the pandemic and to mitigate its impact on the population. The Program was developed in close coordination and consultation with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), which confirmed in its 2020 Debt Sustainability Analysis (DSA) that the country remains at moderate risk of debt distress, with some room for concessional borrowing.

description.narrative: COVID-19 outbreak more effectively managed and its immediate adverse social and economic effects reduced.

100% of 24 designated quarantine hospitals have necessary equipment to manage 30 COVID-19 cases per day and undertake outbreak investigation (2019 baseline: NA) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: Target level achieved by end of first full year of operation. Data Source: Hospital records and MOF annual budget reports

At least 100% of vulnerable households (of which at least 35% are female-headed) benefited from use of support provided by the program (March 2020 baseline: no program in place). Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: Target level achieved by end of first full year of operation. Data Source: Data from surveys conducted post-program (by Government and/or other organizations) will be used assess use and sufficiency of program's support.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Measures to support COVID-19 health sector response implemented. Indicator: Government provides 24 hospitals designated for COVID-19 surveillance and treatment with the necessary sex-segregated facilities, services and equipment for infection prevention and control, including proper sized PPE and gender responsive individual packages specifically benefitting 29,502 health workers 83% of whom are women (March 2020 baseline: No equipment and infection prevention and control provided). Achievement: 24 Progress/Status: To combat COVID 19, the Government purchased equipment for infection prevention such as PPE, antiseptics, disinfectants, medicines, respirators, consumables for laboratories, express tests and PCR tests, totalling $ 21 million and provided for all engaged medical workers, benefitting at least 29,502 health workers 83% of whom are women. Data Source: MOF annual budget reports

Output: Measures to support COVID-19 health sector response implemented. Indicator: Government provides sex-segregated intensive care wards in 24 designated hospitals for treatment with the necessary technical equipment for case management (March 2020 baseline: No technical equipment for case management provided). Achievement: 24 Progress/Status: For intensive care wards, the Government purchased 40 AVL machines, 40 bedside monitors and 1 portable X-ray machine for a total of $ 0.829 million. Data Source: Special COVID-19 Pandemic Taskforce progress reports

Output: Measures to support State budget stability undertaken. Indicator: At least 25% of government's financing needs for 2020 met (March 2020 baseline: 0%). Achievement: 25 Progress/Status: Changes have been made to the Law of the Kyrgyz Republic "On the Republican Budget of the Kyrgyz Republic for 2020 and the Forecast for 2021-2022", within the framework of which non-priority items of expenditures of the republican budget are optimized and reduced by about $113 million. As of 09/01/2020, current Government financing needs for 2020 met and budget execution is at 25.84%. Data Source: MOF annual budget reports

Output: Measures to support the population and food security introduced. Indicator: Food packages totaling $11.4 million delivered to at least 311,000 vulnerable families, at least 52% of whom are women (100% of those on the list approved by the MLSD (March 2020 baseline: no food packages delivered) Achievement: 11400000 Progress/Status: The government provided social assistance in the form of food packages to 525,105 vulnerable households, including female-headed households. From the republican budget, 148,454 families were provided, from a deposit account - 26,616 families, sponsorship assistance - 285,538 families, the local budget - 64,497 families, in total over $11.4 million. Data Source: MOF annual budget reports and MLSD progress reports

Output: Measures to support State budget stability undertaken. Indicator: Government protects national budget allocation of $240 million for Ministry of Health, to ensure that current health programs such as maternal and child health programs, and provision of reproductive health services will continue even during the pandemic (January 2020 baseline: $240 million budget allocation). Achievement: Y Progress/Status: According to the revised Law on the Republican Budget, the Government allocated $253 million for the healthcare sector in 2020. Data Source: Special COVID-19 Pandemic Taskforce progress reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Measures to support business entities offered. Indicator: Commercial banks prolong and restructure the principal amounts and interest on loans to small and medium-sized enterprises, at least 30% of which are women-owned and/or managed SMEs, for a period of at least 3 months (March 2020 baseline: None).. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The National Bank has prolonged all loans which expire in 2020. Commercial banks revised the terms (restructuring) for 153.3 thousand previously issued loans. The volume of prolonged loans is $ 13.054 million, which is 64.5% of the total loan portfolio of the banking system. Data Source: MOF annual budget reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Measures to support business entities offered. Indicator: Government defers tax debts and social deductions of enterprises that suffered losses from the pandemic, especially benefitting SMEs at least 30% of which are women-owned and/or managed (March 2020 baseline: tax debts and social deductions mandatory and enforced) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: On April 3, 2020, the Law on the provision of deferrals and instalments for the payment of tax arrears and social security contributions, as well as on the non-application of tax sanctions and penalties for late fulfilment of tax obligations until July 1, 2020, was adopted.
Data Source: MOF annual budget reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Measures to support the population and food security introduced. Indicator: Import of flour and grain exempted from value- added tax (March 2020 baseline: no exemption). Achievement: N Progress/Status: The draft Law of the Kyrgyz Republic "On Amendments to the Law of the Kyrgyz Republic" On the Enactment of the Tax Code of the Kyrgyz Republic" was initiated, exempting imports of flour and grain from VAT, which was rejected due to the objections of the President of the Kyrgyz Republic by a resolution of the Jogorku Kenesh of the Kyrgyz Republic dated 27 May 2020 No. 3757-VI "On Rejection of the Law of the Kyrgyz Republic On Amendments to the Law of the Kyrgyz Republic On the Enactment of the Tax Code of the Kyrgyz Republic". However, forming the state reserve of the required amount of food, contracts were drawn up for the supply of milling wheat in the amount of 33 thousand tons with suppliers from the Russian Federation. Deliveries of milling wheat under the signed contracts were carried out from April to May in full.
Data Source: MOF annual budget reports and MLSD progress reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: N
